At Synelixis we aim to pioneer in transformative technologies and deliver customized solutions that empower businesses and communities worldwide. Since our founding in 2007, we have been dedicated to developing effective and high-quality automation and system control solutions. Our commitment extends across key areas, including Corporate Software Development (B2B), Cloud Services, Precision Agriculture, Smart Irrigation, Internet of Things (IoT) integration, and more.

Eurecat is a Research and Technology Organization located in Catalonia (Spain). Eurecat's Digital Technologies Division, based in Barcelona, with 100 professionals specialising in Computer Science, Telecom Engineering, Physics and Mathematics, with ca. 30%
of the staff holding a PhD degree, and a 9.5 M€ turnover (2019). The Division is organised in five Technology Units namely Big Data & Data Science, Smart Management Systems, e-Health, MultiMedia Technologies and IT Security. It performs applied R&D projects under direct contract by Industry and also has a string participation in public funded projectes, particularly EU's H2020.
Data Science and Artificial Intelligence are underlying, transversal technologies with multisector applications (mobility, logistics, retail, agrofood, industrial manufacturing I4.0 and Cibersecurity). The Division's staff consists of skilled data engineers and data scientis with strong background in Big Data technologies and algorithmic knowledge. In terms of facilities the division features a private cluster, an OpenStack based platform developed by Eurecat capable to provision, configure and deploy a whole Big Data stack through an UI assistant matching different project requirements. This platform currently allows to deploy Hadoop environment clusters (including HDFS, YARN, Hive, Pig and Sqoop) as well as Spark, Elasticsearch and Kafka clusters. The Datura hardware resources are 308 CPU 
cores in 11 servers, with 4,48 TB of RAM and 585,12TB of storage space. The network connection within premises is of 20 Gbit/s and located in a private CDP meeting the operational thermal and redundancy requirements. This facility has been recently updated with 8 GPU NVIDIA Cores anhancing the computing power to perform demanding AI, Deep Learning and similar computations.

RadioPoints s.r.l. is a spin-off company of the University of Rome “Tor Vergata”, founded in year 2020. The mission of the company is to transfer to the appropriate markets some of the most recent cutting-edge research results in Radio Communications.
Its scientific team consists of distinguished researchers with many years of experience in the fields of wireless/satellite communication systems, signal processing, RF sensing/localization/tomography.
Notwithstanding the young age of the company, its experienced team has already taken part in several projects for Italian and European customers, including:

- Projects funded by the European Space Agency (ESA): ARIADNA extended study named “The Flower Constellation Set and its Possible Applications”, in 2006. Multipurpose Constellation project, in 2009. TESHEALTH (Telemedicine Services for Health) project, from 2010 to 2011. AIS End-to-End Testbed Development and "Miniaturized Low-Weight Space Antenna for AIS VHF Applications, from 2012 to 2014.

TESEI (Development of a GNSS multifunctional and reconfigurable terminal).

- Project jointly funded by ASI and ESA: Alphasat “Aldo Paraboni” Payload (Technology Demonstration Payload – TDP 5) scientific experiments for broadband satellite communications in Q/V band.

- Projects funded by the European Commission: MAGNET (My personal Adaptive Global NET) European FP6 integrated project, from January 2004 to December 2005; SatNEx European network of excellence, from January 2004 to December 2005, MAGNET Beyond European FP6 integrated project, from January 2006 to June 2008; QV-LIFT, H2020-COMPET-2016 Project.

Machine Prognostics (MP) is a Norwegian company developing machine monitoring systems able to monitor critical and complex assets, e.g. ship engine propulsion gearbox, for the maritime and O&G industry. Our rapid and ambitious go-to-market strategy relies on a technological cross-innovation from the aerospace sector. Our novel sensor and algorithms initially developed for monitoring helicopters critical components, e.g. helicopter main rotor gearbox, are re-engineered to be used with maritime assets in our product called “Foresight Maritime” referred to as Foresight in this proposal. This cross-innovation approach dramatically increases the commercial potential of MP in the Maritime sector by introducing disruptive yet, trustable aerospace-proven/certified algorithms embedded into our sensors. 

Our vision is to empower maintenance crews all over the world by providing them with reliable actionable information about the health status of their machinery; anyone can understand Foresight data without prior training. Our user interface has been designed around the maintainer for ease of use and to provide clear, unambiguous information. When components show wears, Foresight removes the guesswork by providing time estimates of equipment remaining useful life and can even automatically trigger work-order when connected to the maintenance planning system of the ship/platform.

Spade is a creative agency specialised in product design for Space exploration. 
We imagine new ergonomics for microgravity, and give shape to human culture outside of Earth.

We have entered a new space era : the upcoming private space sector and the perspective of a journey to Mars are leading to a commercial revolution in Space. The future pioneers won’t just be military or scientific, but rather philanthropists, explorers, voyageurs and even tourists, having much different journeys than yesterday’s astronauts. 

The popular imaginary would let us think that space stations are slick white minimalist environments, where everything is integrated and ergonomic. It is in fact, quite the opposite : at present, Space is surprisingly crowded with dysfunctional objects manufactured for a world with gravity, where weight and direction applied. As a result, practical problems continuously arise and are currently solved with black duct tape and velcro strips: the astronaut’s best friends.

We, at Spade, believe in better planned environments, cleverly-designed objects, and specific ergonomics for manned spaceflights.

entityDescription:
Surrey NanoSystems began as a spin-out from the University of Surrey's Advanced Technology Institute in December 2006. Surrey NanoSystems initial goal was the development of commercial systems for producing carbon nanotubes at temperatures compatible with back end silicon processing. The company's initial financial backer was the IP Group PLC and The University of Surrey.
The first development project was the creation of a range of nanomaterial growth platforms known as NanoGrowth. This work - and the focus on producing materials to support the continued scaling of semiconductor devices - led to an evolution in the capability of the CVD deposition tools under the NanoGrowth Catalyst brand.
In 2012, Surrey NanoSystems' low temperature nanomaterial growth capability led to a project partnership to develop super-black coatings to enhance the performance of sensitive electro-optical imaging systems in a satellite application. This partnership with NPL and ABSL SPACE PRODUCTS resulted in the creation of Vantablack - Vertically Aligned Nanotube Array BLACK - an array of carbon nanotubes with remarkable properties for trapping light. 
Today Vantablack is now a globally recognised super-black coatings brand that stands for ultimate performance and quality of service in critical technology driven industries. The original CVD Vantablack coating is no longer manufactured as it has been superseded by Vantablack spray coatings that solve serious challenges in space, optics, automotive sensing and aesthetics.
We currently operate out of two world class R&D and production facilities in the UK based near Brighton, East Sussex. Vantablack coatings are the sole focus of the company.
